channel.title: Last Night On Sports
channel.description: Your daily 5-minute sports recap. Every morning, Marcus and Elena break down last night's biggest games, scores and storylines across the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college sports, soccer and more, like two friends talking sports over coffee. New episodes every morning. Note: the hosts are AI-generated voices, and episodes are produced with AI tools and fact-checked against the day's results.

item.title: Last Night On Sports 11/19/26: Houston Stuns Top-Ranked Florida
item.description: No. 8 Houston upset No. 1 Florida 86-76 in Las Vegas, and No. 12 Arizona beat No. 3 UConn. The episode also covers the Jazz's upset of the Lakers, the 76ers' 13-3 start, Alcaraz and Tiafoe at the ATP Finals, Canadiens-Devils, and tonight's Colts-Texans Thursday Night Football. It also touches on Drake Maye's injury and GTA 6's release day. Hosts are AI-generated voices.
